answer: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Tags LIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = -1
note: Community (id -1) has 211 posts, none with tags, so result is 0.00

answer: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users ORDER BY Reputation DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u JOIN badges o ON o.UserId = u.Id AND o.Name = 'Organizer' WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.UserId = u.Id AND b.Date < o.Date) >= 5
note: read 'had already earned 5' as at least 5; exactly 5 would give 2, at least 5 gives 11

answer: SELECT Id, DisplayName, Views, Reputation FROM users WHERE (Location LIKE '%California%' OR Location GLOB '*CA' OR Location GLOB '*CA[^a-zA-Z]*') AND Location NOT LIKE '%Canada%' AND Views = (SELECT MAX(Views) FROM users WHERE (Location LIKE '%California%' OR Location GLOB '*CA' OR Location GLOB '*CA[^a-zA-Z]*') AND Location NOT LIKE '%Canada%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u WHERE u.Location LIKE '%India%' AND u.Location NOT LIKE '%Indian%' AND u.Location NOT LIKE '%\%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b.UserId = u.Id AND b.Name = 'Yearling' AND b.Date < '2014-01-01')
note: excluded Indiana/Indianapolis and one junk LaTeX location

answer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(CAST(p.OwnerUserId AS TEXT), p.OwnerDisplayName)) FROM votes v JOIN posts p ON p.Id = v.PostId WHERE v.VoteTypeId = 8 AND v.BountyAmount >= 30 AND v.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01' AND v.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
